public_rationale: The forecast has no deadline. Research documents persistent hallucinations, but that cannot prove they will never disappear. Work on abstention and bounded solutions also prevents treating inevitability as established. No cited event meets the early-resolution rule for either a general solution or a decisive impossibility proof.
limitations: An open-ended impossibility claim cannot be supported merely by waiting.
The result depends on distinguishing a general solution from narrow task-specific guarantees.
The search does not establish that no qualifying solution could exist.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Hallucinations in generative AI models cannot be fixed and will not go away.

statement.excerpt: You simply cannot fix them. Hallucinations are not going away.

our_interpretation: This is an unconditional, open-ended claim that hallucinations cannot be eliminated.

The ordinary reading concerns persistent fabrication in useful general-purpose generative systems. It does not require answering every possible question correctly; appropriate abstention may be part of a solution.
Lower error rates, perfect scores on a finite narrow test, and systems that always abstain do not by themselves establish elimination of the general problem.
criteria.support_condition: A decisive impossibility result establishes that hallucinations cannot be eliminated within the claimed scope. Continued hallucinations in a finite set of models are insufficient to prove 'cannot' or 'will not'.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A publicly available, useful general-purpose generative system is independently and reproducibly shown to eliminate hallucinations across its intended broad uses, including appropriate handling of uncertainty.

evidence.excerpt: Finding: They are not, because language models can abstain when uncertain.
evidence.explanation: This is material counterevidence to a categorical inevitability argument. It identifies abstention as a possible remedy but does not independently demonstrate a broadly useful system that has eliminated hallucinations.

evidence.explanation: Despite its hallucination-free title, the proposed method addresses GUI coordinate grounding. That bounded scope does not satisfy the rule for eliminating hallucinations in general-purpose generation.
